segments.text: Then Claire hears Frank crying alone in the RV. Frank and his wife almost never spend time apart, but she’s away on a cruise and Frank showed up by himself. Claire starts wondering if something is wrong in their marriage.

segments.text: Phil doesn’t buy it. His father is the happiest person he knows, and the two of them have spent years turning every serious moment into a joke. Claire points out that they talk all the time, but they never actually talk about anything.

segments.text: Just before Frank leaves, Phil finally asks him directly what’s going on. Frank says he has fallen in love. Phil braces himself for a family disaster. Then Frank explains that he means Scout. After spending days on the road with the dog, he can’t stand leaving him behind.
